title: NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable set at container runtime is ignored and the browser still sees the build-time value
symptoms: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is undefined in the browser even though the container has it set
Staging and production images built once both call the staging API
Changing the variable in the hosting dashboard has no effect until a rebuild
cause: next build replaces every literal process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_* reference in client code with the value present at build time. The shipped JavaScript no longer reads the environment, so runtime values never reach it.
fix: Pass public values as build args and rebuild per environment, or read a server-only variable in a Server Component and hand it to the client as a prop. Dynamic lookups like process.env[name] are not inlined at all.
apply:
# Dockerfile
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
RUN npm run build

# docker build --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.example.com .
affected: All Next.js versions with next build, most visible with one Docker image promoted across environments
